0.msg: A music box? Hm, I think I remember... But it's strange that we #bawakened ones can't hear it#k. Maybe that's the #bdevice maintaining the dreams#k of the townspeople.

2.msg: I'm sorry, but could you follow Protective Mask? She has a tendency to jump blindly into the path of danger. I want you to look after her.

yes.0: Thanks. Remember, both of you must return safely.

no.0: I see... Talk to me when you change your mind.

0.msg: I see you arrived without incident.

1.msg: #bI saw some strange things on the way here...

2.msg: Don't mind them. There is nothing truly strange in the #rcity of dreams#k.

yes.0: Now start talking to the townspeople and gather information on the #bmusic box#k. I will keep an eye out for the Dreamkeepers.

0.msg: I leave Protective Mask to you. Go to the Noisy Market.
